# Live audience

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Guests join a live session on their phone and interact (react, vote, chat), anonymously, with a per-session token and no account. Build your own; there is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.audience-live`.

Kit: @kit/ui Field, @kit/ui FormCard.
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Anonymous: a per-session token, never an account.
- Throttled join, avatar and interaction endpoints.
- A freshness and offline state on the guest's screen.
- A retention purge that covers uploaded media.
- No tracking beyond the session feed.
- Joining uses kit Form and Field; use kit RadioCard and EmojiTray once they ship (queued as kit gaps).

Related: `ui-page.stage-display`, `ui-page.live-console`.

Graduates: Graduate to a kit recipe when a second app needs it.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Which live or in-person experience?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.audience-live` to see its siblings.
